crossRefs.note: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were…
But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.
Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors…
They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability…
Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
It will happen that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be…
For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”
All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”
Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works…
If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.
You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should…
“In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he…
Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.
But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be…

translations.web: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.
translations.bsb: After they had prayed, their meeting place was shaken, and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.
translations.kjv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were assembled together; and they were all filled with the Holy Ghost, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
translations.asv: And when they had prayed, the place was shaken wherein they were gathered together; and they were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spake the word of God with boldness.
